profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Visa
profile.summary: Software Development Engineer (11+ years of experience) with a demonstrated track record as a technical lead and full stack developer. MS in Software Engineering from San Jose State University.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Technical lead and full stack developer implementing payment gateways.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Part of a Visa's Merchant and Acquirer Payment Acceptance team called Cybersource. CyberSource is an E-commerce credit card payment system which enables merchants to accept and manage payments, mitigate fraud, and secure their payment data. http://www.cybersource.com/ 

- Led mPOS - mobile point of sale project. Architect, design and developed Android SDK and mobile application to accept EMV chip card, swiped, keyed-in and quick chip transactions in mobile phone using card reader. 
https://github.com/CyberSource/cybersource-mPOS-sdk-android  

- Delivered end to end solution including analysis of Merchant and Acquirer requirements, design and development of the payment gateways which process Credit, Debit and EMV chip card payment transactions in a real time with Visa's high security standards. 

Technologies and tools: Java, Rest/Soap web services, Spring framework, Oracle and Cassandra DB, Docker, Consul, Redis, Jenkins, Git.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern - Mobile Devices Engineering
positions.description:
Android application development 
Technologies: Android SDK, Java, Google Cloud Messaging, Perl Scripting

JIRA Performance Baseline -  Developed tool to measure JIRA performance 
Technologies: Jython(java+python), Shell Scripting, The Grinder

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Technologies: Java, Apache Hadoop, Apache Mahout

Worked as a software developer on a machine learning research project named "Query Recommendation" supervised by Dr. Eirinaki Magdalini. Main goal of the project was to create Query Recommendation System for relational databases using Matrix Factorization algorithm.

company.name: San Jose State University Research Foundation

projects.title: Event Planning Portal
projects.description:
Technologies: HTML5, CSS, AJAX, JavaScript, JQuery, Charts, Front Caching, Servlet, MySQL

Developed event management website where user is directed with task-list of different events. It allows user to manage their events and also see expense summary along with charts. This is front-end focused project.

projects.title: IBM Watson The Great Mind Challenge Competition 2013
projects.description:
Technologies: Data mining algorithms, Hadoop, Apache Mahout, Weka

Participated in The Great Mind Challenge data mining competition held by IBM.  Developed an algorithm by combining data mining algorithms to find most accurate answer from a large dataset. Used Apache Mahout and Weka Java APIs. 

- Got 7th position out of 35 teams from different universities.
